claims.citation: New York Herald, 23 May 1866, p. 11, col. 4
claims.verbatim:
Steamship Bavaria (Ham), Taube, Hamburg May 6, with
mdse and 855 passengers, to Kunhardt & Co. May 8, off Fal-
mouth, saw steamship America (Brem), bound E; 13th, lat
48 10, lon 29 30, ship John Bright, from Liverpool, for New
York; 15th, lat 46 30[?], lon 39, ship Eliza Caroline (Br), bound
W; 21st, lat 40 20, lon 69, steamship City of Limerick, bound
E; same day, lat 40 30, lon 70, bark Warren White (of Salem),
bound N.
